subject: Re: Redwood pricing for CloudMatrix — alignment and pilot credit request
messages:
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Aidan Cross <aidan@cloudmatrix.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood proposal and packaging for CloudMatrix pilot

Hi Aidan —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a compact proposal that maps your platform usage (real-time chat + embeddings) to our most cost-efficient Dedicated bundle and the recommended pilot flow. Highlights:

- 30-day technical pilot with up to 2M prompt tokens and 500k embedding units included as pilot credits.
- Option to convert to a 12-month committed tier for a blended unit price and reserved capacity (preferred for consistent latency).
- We can match the line-item price for the embedding units from the competitor quote you shared (see note below) if CloudMatrix signs a 12-month commitment with a 20% up-front credit applied to month 1.

I attached the proposal and the competitor PDF you mentioned so we can annotate differences. I flagged the three areas where our runtime and SLA materially differ from the competitor (prefix caching, model variant fallbacks, and observability retention).

Next steps: can you confirm which features in the competitor quote are must-haves vs nice-to-have? If you confirm the 12-month target, I’ll loop in legal and finance and put together an SOW with the matching line-item.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood-Proposal-CloudMatrix-20260205.pdf

Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 10:07:00 -0800

Jasmine —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the annotated proposal. A few clarifications from our procurement side:

1) The competitor is offering a straight unit-price reduction (no upfront) but requires a 12‑month commit. Their embedding unit price is 22% lower than your standard list. Can Redwood match that exact per-unit price without the 20% up-front credit?

2) We also want an extension to the pilot: 45 days and 3M prompt tokens (our load tests spike around month-end).

3) Legal flagged a data residency note; they want a clause about audit logs kept for 12 months — can you confirm?

Attached is the competitor quote you referenced (CloudMatrix-Competitor-Quote-20260204.pdf). If you can provide a clean SOW with the price number and updated pilot terms, we’ll share it with Procurement tomorrow.

—Aidan
Head of Platform, CloudMatrix

Subject: Fwd: CloudMatrix pricing ask — internal alignment

Looping in Jordan for legal/finance on the residency and pricing ask. My take: we can match the competitor embedding unit price exactly if CloudMatrix converts to a 12-month committed plan and agrees to a small minimum monthly throughput (to avoid churn). In lieu of the 20% up-front credit, propose instead: 8% onboarding credit + extended pilot (45 days) and a one-time migration credit of $8k. That preserves cashflow while getting them to commit.

Jordan — can legal add the 12-month audit-log clause to the SOW (logs retained for 12 months, exportable)? Finance — flag the effect on ARR and approval threshold (this will be an exception to standard discount tiers).

Ben
VP, Sales Enablement

Thanks — we can do the match. Final offer (for SOW/v1):

- Embedding unit price: matched to competitor quote (line-item parity) on a signed 12-month committed plan.
- Pilot: 45 days, up to 3M prompt tokens and 500k embedding units included as pilot credits; pilot will convert into month 1 of the commitment if you sign before pilot end.
- Migration credit: one-time $8,000 applied as a bill credit in month 2 (we kept this in to accelerate timeline).
- Data residency/audit logs: 12-month exportable audit logs clause included in SOW.
- Condition: pricing parity contingent on 12-month commit and a minimum monthly throughput clause (outlined in SOW, small floor to limit short-term arbitrage).

I’ve attached the draft SOW (SOW-CloudMatrix-v2.docx) and a DocuSign packet link for the SOW + Order Form. If this looks good, I can have Legal send a redline-free SOW for signature within 24 hours.
